newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Ansett, SIA, Air NZ see full alliance soon.
newsitem.headline: Ansett, SIA, Air NZ see full alliance soon.

text.p: Ansett Airlines, Singapore Airlines Ltd and Air New Zealand Ltd said on Friday the three expected their proposed alliance contract to be finalised in about two months.

"This is a memorandum of understanding. We would hope that in the order of a couple of months that we can finalise the contract which will come from it," Greg Wallace, the manager of Ansett's international operations told a news conference.
Wallace said the airlines would then collectively submit the contract to monopolies watchdog, the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC), for official approval.
Ansett managing director Rod Eddington said he could not estimate how long it would take before it was given sanction.

Air New Zealand's managing director Jim McCrea said the New Zealand carrier would shortly start code-sharing with Singapore Airlines but that this move would require the approval of New Zealand's ministry of transport.
"As the memorandum of understanding unfolds into other areas of cooperation there may be need to seek Commerce Commission approval. None of that seems to be insurmountable," McCrea said.
Singapore Airlines's chief executive and deputy chairman Cheong Choong Kong said there were no regulatory hurdles for the alliance in Singapore.
Ansett is a joint venture between Air New Zealand and News Corp Ltd.
